Furthermore, its test in `registry.test.ts` ("does not echo identifying data in rejection message") is not linked in `specs/hal-engine-tool-input-validation/spec.md`, which fails `re-lint/require-spec-link`. Finally, it leaves `.lore/dod.md` and a duplicate `registry.acceptance.test.ts` file in the diff, and misses required documentation details in `docs/adding-a-tool.md` (which awkwardly tells tool authors to return a rejection ToolResponse for unknown keys) and `.specify/spec.md`."}
